title: Theta operators at $t=1$, Macdonald cumulants, and LLT positivity
summary: We study the Theta operators of D'Adderio-Iraci-Vanden Wyngaerd at $t=1$ and show that the power-sum-indexed operators $Θ_{\mathsf p_k}|_{t=1}$ agree with a commuting family of derivations when restricted to symmetric functions of positive degree. Writing $\widetilde{h}_a$ for the modified Macdonald function indexed by the single row $(a)$ we establish that $Θ_{\mathsf p_μ}\widetilde{h}_a|_{t=1}$ is, up to a normalization, the single-row Macdonald cumulant of Dolęga.
